issues.issue: Was the RAD's credibility assessment of the Principal Applicant reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Inconsistencies were minor and tangential; the Principal Applicant was very nervous while testifying.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that the RAD’s determination regarding the credibility of the Principal Applicant was reasonable

issues.issue: Did the RAD unreasonably ignore the plausibility of an oral loan and the landlord's corroboration?
issues.applicant_position: RAD neglected the plausibility of an oral loan agreement and under-weighed the landlord's corroborating evidence.
issues.result_quote: Contrary to the assertion of the Applicants, the RAD did consider the plausibility of an oral agreement and rejected it

issues.issue: Did the RAD fail to conduct its own independent assessment of the record?
issues.applicant_position: RAD failed to conduct its own independent assessment of the record.
issues.result_quote: I find that the Applicants’ assertion that the RAD failed to conduct an independent assessment is without merit.
